title: Integration of Skewed-Poisson Structures on Non-commutative Formal Groups
note: The owner identifies this thesis with arXiv:math/0602138 (leitner2006, held at library/arxiv-math-0602138v1/), uploaded 2026-11-21 as the thesis; cite leitner2006 for theorem numbers. Over a field of characteristic p, strongly filtered, strongly multiplicative Poisson structures on the splay of distribution algebras of commutative formal groups integrate to non-commutative formal groups. Until 2026-11-21 this note said strong multiplicativity preserves the comultiplication under lifting from characteristic p to characteristic 0; arXiv:math/0602138 contains no such lift. The thesis PDF itself is not held, so its text was not compared.
